description: OVS QoS queue definitions for National Disaster Response Network (Review 1)
notes: Rates are in bits/sec (OVS other-config min-rate / max-rate).
Queue 1 = legacy public bulk class, rate-limited.
Minimum rates are guarantees under contention, maximum rates are caps; no HTB scheduling priority is configured.
All 11 configured egress ports are managed; their root rate follows link capacity.
Concurrent h2 and h7 streams to h4 share s2-eth4 (50 Mbps).
OVS HTB may replace TCLink switch qdiscs; the harness records the actual state.

qos_port.comment: Egress from s2 to Ambulance — shared 50 Mbps bottleneck
